sentence: Investment efficiency responds more where knowledge intensity, R&D spending and internal controls are strong
passage: [Lin, Li et al. (2026), p. 1] "This effect is more pronounced in high knowledge-intensity firms, high R&D-intensity firms, and firms with sound internal controls."

gemini.note: The sentence accurately paraphrases the passage's statement that the effect is more pronounced in firms with high knowledge intensity, high R&D intensity, and sound internal controls.
